prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
Rules:
- The same product has the same brand and the same model number. Differences in colour,
  capacity, size or bundle contents (when they change the model number) mean a different product.
- Ignore wording differences, marketing text and price differences.
- If no candidate is clearly the same product, answer "none". Do not guess.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>, "reason": "<short sentence>"}

Price-list item:
name: Transcend 133X High-Speed 4GB Compact Flash Card - TS4GCF133; description: Transcend 133X High-Speed 4GB Compact Flash Card - TS4GCF133/ 21.5MB Per Sec. Data Transfer Rate/ Dual-Channel Support/ Multi-Platform Compatibility/ Supports Ultra DMA Mode 0-4/ Low Power Consumption

Candidates:
1. name: Transcend 8GB Compact Flash Card (133x) - TS8GCF133; brand: TRANSCEND INFORMATION; description: Transcend 8GB CompactFlash Card (133x)
2. name: Transcend 2GB CompactFlash Card (133x) - TS2GCF133; brand: TRANSCEND INFORMATION
3. name: Transcend 4GB Secure Digital High Capacity (SDHC) Card - Class 6 - TS4GSDHC6; brand: TRANSCEND INFORMATION; description: Transcend 4GB SDHC Class 6 Secure Digital High Capacity Card; price: $5.74
